==Background==
{{Quote|Bow down and worship our great Conchita|Arte and Pollo, Banica's servants}}

This song was uploaded on March 3, 2009, and is the first MEIKO original song to achieve 1,000,000 views.

The song concerns Banica Conchita (MEIKO), a woman who, at one time, ate only the most delicious and exquisite food. Now, however, her tastes have evolved so that she wants something new and grotesque every day, and nothing enters or leaves her palace. One day, the fifteenth personal chef of the year Joseph ([[KAITO]]) asks for a brief vacation (in an attempt to flee). She refuses, and eventually eats him after he poisoned himself. Soon after, she ends up eating her butler Pollo (Len) and maid Arte (Rin), and when everything has gone, she ends up eating herself. Its initial phrase is 「さあ、残さず食べなさい｣ ("Now, eat up without leaving anything").

This song is one of the tracks of Akuno-P's Seven Deadly Sins Series.

The original version of this song has entered the ''[[Hall of Legend]]'' while the SCP version has surpassed 3 million views on YouTube.

{{Main|Seven Deadly Sins|The Evillious Chronicles}}

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song is featured in following albums:
* [[Evils Theater]] (Original)
* [[悪食娘コンチータ（改） (Akujiki Musume Conchita (Kai))|Evil Food Eater Conchita (Revised)]] (Revised version)
* [[悪ノ王国〜Evils Kingdom〜 (Aku no Oukoku 〜Evils Kingdom〜)|Evils Kingdom]] (Revised version)
* [[七つの罪と罰 (Nanatsu no Tsumi to Batsu)|Seven Crimes and Punishments]] (SCP version)
* Saribitotachi no Waltz Aku no Taizai SEKAI EDITION+ (SCP version)
* Kakumei no Aka (Original & 2026 MEIKO Only version)

This song is featured in following compilation albums:
* [[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS Vocaloanthems feat. 初音ミク|Vocaloanthems]] (Revised)
* [[月刊eta Vol.08 (Gekkaneta Vol.08)|Monthlyeta Vol.08]] (Original)
